answer: Require each key to commit to a random public forecast—such as whether tomorrow’s rainfall at a named station exceeds a threshold—under a marble/violet/ripple nonce. After the event, an independent oracle signs the result; the registry consumes that event ID and returns the bond only for an on-time reveal within tolerance, slashing missed or inaccurate forecasts and rejecting duplicate commits. Proposed bond: .75 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent locks .75 once; 1,000 fake identities lock ,750 (1,000 × .75). Limitation: outcomes are noisy and oracles can collude.
